user.title: Connect to Canvas LMS
user.description:
Enter your Canvas instance URL and Personal Access Token.

To generate an Access Token:
1. In Canvas Global Navigation, click **Account** and then **Settings**.
2. Under **Approved Integrations**, click **+ New Access Token**.
3. Enter a Purpose (e.g., `Home Assistant`) and click **Generate Token**.
4. Copy the generated token and paste it below.

data_description.base_url: The web address of your school's Canvas instance (e.g., school.instructure.com or canvas.university.edu).
data_description.access_token: Personal access token generated in Canvas under Account > Settings > Approved Integrations > + New Access Token.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Canvas LMS
reauth_confirm.description:
The existing access token is invalid or expired. Please enter a valid access token.

To generate a new Access Token in Canvas, go to **Account** > **Settings** > **Approved Integrations** > **+ New Access Token**.

data_description.access_token: Personal access token generated in Canvas under Account > Settings > Approved Integrations > + New Access Token.
